r1.exp: 1=A (forgive me = I’m sorry), 2=E (what should I do? = give me advice), 3=B (you’ve been a real help = thank you), 4=F (I’d love you to be there = join us), 5=D (leave me alone = do not disturb). C je suvišno.

r6.exp: Layla kaže da Harvey smije pričati o zabavi, ali ne smije reći da ona i Derek izlaze (dating) → tajni je boyfriend (new boyfriend).

r7.exp: Matthew nije znao gradivo jer je bio bolestan. Test mu je bio težak (couldn’t do it). Misli da je ocjena nepravična, ali pitanje je o testu, ne o ocjeni.

r8.exp: ‘Every other day’ = svaki drugi dan = otprilike 3-4 puta tjedno. Jednom tjedno je ono čemu teži, ali još ne radi.

r9.exp: Roditelji joj ne daju izaći (won’t let me) → because of her parents. Loše ocjene su razlog roditelja, ali odluka je roditeljska.

r10.exp: Projekt predaju četvrtkom? Ne — predaju ga u petak (hand it in on Friday). Srijeda je rok za Sienna’s dio, ali predaja je u petak.

r11.exp: Nathan radi kao učitelj engleskog (English teacher) u Gapu. Slikanje je za vikende.

r12.exp: Nathan je studirao arhitekturu (architecture) — kaže da mu je dalo disciplinu.

r13.exp: Nathan je Lonđanin (“a Londoner”) — rodni grad je London.

r14.exp: ‘Shepherdess’ nije na prodaju i uvijek je želi imati u ateljeju → omiljena slika.

r15.exp: ‘Moonlight’ je slika koja ga je proslavila i onu na plakatima londonskog metroa.

pairs.r: B — so he decided to open his own shop.
E — and was situated next to a very busy shopping district.
F — which meant the place was full of goods at low prices.
D — it attracted customers from far away.
A — and later his children took over.

r21.exp: ‘A job’ = posao (uzčlančeni). ‘Work’ je nebroj, ‘money’ ne odgovara kontekstu prijave za au pair.

r22.exp: ‘As a person’ = kao osoba. ‘As’ u ulozi/svojstvu. ‘Like’ bi značilo sličnost, ne identifikaciju.

r23.exp: ‘Tell jokes’ = pričati šale. Fiksna kolokacija — ne ‘speak/say jokes’.

r24.exp: ‘Be great at something’ = biti dobar u nečemu. Fiksna prepozicija: ‘at’.

r25.exp: ‘Some experience’ = neko iskustvo (nebroj. imenica). ‘Lot’ zahtijeva ‘a lot of’, ‘an’ ne ide uz nebroj. imenice.

r26.exp: ‘Only a few’ = samo nekolicina. ‘Few’ s brojevima/množinom — suprotno od ‘many’.

r27.exp: ‘Good enough’ = dovoljno dobro. ‘Enough’ dolazi iza pridjeva.

r28.exp: ‘So (that)’ = kako bi, da. Izražava svrhu: ‘make a video so companies can see you’.

r29.exp: ‘Find out who’ = saznaj tko. Indirektno pitanje s ‘who’ kao subjektom.

r30.exp: ‘Look for’ = tražiti. Phrasal verb: companies look for (skaters) = traže skejtaše.

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) koliko domaćih zadaća, (2) što treba znati o testovima, (3) omiljeni predmet i zašto. Primjer: “Hi Thea! We usually have 1-2 hours of homework a day. Tests happen every few weeks — you need to study regularly. My favourite subject is English because I love learning about different cultures. Can’t wait to meet you!”

pairs.r: B — You don’t have to come.

l1.exp: 1=E (you’ll enjoy it = you should come), 2=C (parents out, come over = you can come), 3=B (it’s up to you = you don’t have to), 4=D (girls only, sorry = you cannot come), 5=A (everyone must be there = you have to come). F je suvišno.

l6.exp: Iz transkripta: “Wex. That’s W-E-X.” → Mr. Wex.

l7.exp: Hotel = €25 po osobi = €50 za dvoje. Apartman = €40 za dvoje, ali ne uključuje hranu. Odlučili za hotel → €50 dnevno.

l8.exp: Iz transkripta: kupuju knjigu (“It won the Booker Prize for fiction”, “I’ll just pay for it”) → knjižara (bookshop).

l9.exp: Iz transkripta: Katie je zaboravila staviti domaću zadaću u torbu (“I forgot to put it in my bag”) → she left it at home.

l10.exp: Pića već imaju, CD-ove donosi jedan od njih. Trebaju kupiti kikiriki (peanuts) — “We have to get peanuts.”

l11.exp: Chuck: “I’m glad it was for the album because it shows more of your work than a single.” → Best Album.

l12.exp: Chuck: “Why are people violent? It’s because they’re frustrated. This is the real issue.” → frustration.

l13.exp: Chuck: “He taught me my first chords when I was 4.” (s 2 godine se igrao gitarom, ali svirati počeo s 4).

l14.exp: Chuck: “It’s where we first played for money” → klub. Prva nastupa (besplatno) bila je na školskim plesnjacima, ali prva profesionalna (za novac) bila je u klubovima.

l15.exp: Chuck: “We plan to tour round the country... and we need some more songs for that.” → First writes songs, then tours. Iduće: pisanje pjesama.

l17.exp: Gym radi pon-sri do 20h, zadnji ulaz 1 sat prije zatvaranja → zadnji ulaz u utorak je u 19h (7 pm).

l18.exp: Transkript: “guests are not allowed to use the gym before they see a qualified instructor.” Termin je preporučen, ali obveza je vidjeti instruktora.

l19.exp: Transkript: “There is a fee for this, but there is no extra charge for members.” → za članove je uključeno u članstvo (in the membership price).

l20.exp: Transkript: “There is also a volunteer programme... If you are interested in helping out, please contact us.” → traže volontere.
